subject: Recap & POC plan: Redwood POC for ACME — success criteria & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Susan Patel <susan.patel@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & POC plan: Redwood POC for ACME — success criteria & timeline

Hi John / Susan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria, ownership, and timelines. I tried to keep this concise so we can lock the dates and get procurement looped in.

1) Objective / Success criteria (what ACME will evaluate)
- Integration: Redwood ingests ACME logs and returns generation/embedding responses with <200ms median tail latency for 95% of requests under the test workload.
- Cost: per-request token cost stays within the budget threshold (TBD by finance) — target is ~30% lower than current baseline.
- Quality: prompt->response accuracy for the 3 test prompts (support triage, product summary, search relevancy) meets or exceeds current baseline by n/a or shows no regression (we'll use the eval harness).
- Stability: sustained throughput of 20 qps for 30 minutes without errors.

2) POC scope and evaluation plan
- Data: ACME will provide a 10k-row sample dataset (anonymized) + schema. Redwood will run inference against the sample set.
- Tests: latency/cost benchmarks, functional checks, and automated evals (we will run your prompt suite).
- Success gating: all of the above must be met or have mitigations agreed by final readout.

3) Timeline / milestones (proposed)
- Kickoff (technical onboarding + access): Week of Mar 8 (we can move earlier if helpful)
- Week 1: Data ingestion + connectivity (SSO, API keys, ingest scripts)
- Week 2: Baseline runs + tuning (batching, quantization suggestions)
- Week 3: Stability testing + regression checks + final tuning
- Final readout: Week of Mar 29 — demo + results + next steps (expand / dedicated)

Weekly check-ins: 30-minute sync each Friday (standing invite to follow).

4) Ownership & contacts
- ACME: John Doe (Head of ML) — overall POC owner; Susan Patel (Platform Eng) — technical lead; procurement looped for PO.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM) — project manager / primary contact; Laura Bennett (AE) — commercial; Dylan Brooks (SRE/SE) — technical lead for integration & telemetry.

5) Next steps (action items)
- ACME: confirm success criteria and sample data timeline (who will provide the anonymized 10k rows).
- ACME: confirm preferred kickoff week (we proposed week of Mar 8; open to earlier).
- Redwood: send POC plan PDF and ingestion specs; create HubSpot deal record and calendar invites.
- Procurement: confirm PO process and required contract/PO templates.

Attachments & links: POC-Plan-ACME-2026.pdf (attached), POC doc in Drive (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C-POC-Plan). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-RED-2026-01

If everyone is aligned I can send calendar invites for the proposed weekly cadence and a kickoff on Mar 8. If you prefer earlier, let me know preferred days/times.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: POC-Plan-ACME-2026.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and very aligned with what we discussed. A couple quick questions before we lock dates:

- Can you confirm Redwood's default data retention for POC data and whether ACME can request deletion after the POC? We need that for our security/compliance team.
- For the sample dataset: 10k rows sounds fine. Is there a preferred file format/size limit? We'll likely provide CSVs and a small S3 bucket.

Also — procurement asked if we can push kickoff earlier if possible (week of Mar 1) to get readout before a leadership offsite on Apr 2. Is an earlier kickoff feasible on your side?

If it helps, I can make Mar 4 or Mar 5 available for a kickoff session.

- John

John —

Short answers:
- Data retention: for POCs our default is 30 days retention for logs and artifacts, but we can support a shorter retention window or immediate deletion on request; we will add a deletion confirmation step at the end of the engagement (we'll document in the POC plan).
- Sample format: CSV or newline-delimited JSON is fine. S3 is preferred for larger payloads. For a 10k-row sample we typically see a zip under 500MB.

Earlier kickoff: we can accommodate Mar 4. Let's plan kickoff on Thu, Mar 4 (30–60 min) for technical onboarding and SSO/API key exchange, then start ingestion the same day. I will send the calendar invite once you confirm a time — what time zone are you in? (I see you in ET).

Updated timeline attached (moved everything earlier to align with Mar 4 kickoff).

Action items for ACME to confirm:
- Provide anonymized 10k rows to S3 or share via secure link by Mon, Mar 1.
- Share contact for SSO setup (Okta or Azure AD admin).

I've also created the HubSpot record and added the POC milestones there: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-RED-2026-01

Thanks —
Marissa

[Attachment: POC-Plan-ACME-2026.pdf (updated timeline attached)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: POC technical notes & ingestion specs

Hi John / Marissa —

I wanted to add a few technical details ahead of the Mar 4 kickoff so the ACME platform team can prepare:

- Ingest specs: we accept S3 presigned URLs or an SCP transfer. Preferred format: ndjson or CSV. Each record should include the prompt/input and a stable ID for traceability. See attached spec.
- Sample size: 10k rows is perfect; for performance runs we may sample or replay to hit 20 qps sustained. If you have a separate production-like workload file we can use that as well.
- Telemetry: we will add request-level latency and token usage telemetry. We'll provide a shared dashboard and temporary read-only access.
- SSO: We support Okta/OIDC and can do a short SAML exchange. For kickoff we need an Okta admin or OIDC client credentials to configure.
- Security: POC runs on isolated project accounts and data is encrypted at rest. We will provide a deletion certificate at POC completion per Marissa's note.

Attachment: redwood-poc-ingest-specs.md (contains JSON schema example and example ingestion curl commands).

I can join the kickoff on Mar 4 between 10am–2pm ET — Marissa, can you propose a time? John, if that window works for you please confirm.

Thanks —
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
